title: Rotation invariance forces coefficients onto divisible indices
statement: Let w be a positive natural number, P : ℂ → ℂ, and p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ. Suppose HasFPowerSeriesAt P p 0, meaning that p is a convergent power-series expansion of P at zero. Write a_n = p.coeff n = p_n(1,…,1). Put ζ = exp(2πi/w). If there exists a real s > 0 such that P(ζt) = P(t) whenever ‖t‖ < s, then a_n = 0 for every natural n not divisible by w.
lean_statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ), 0 < w → HasFPowerSeriesAt P p 0 → (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < s → P (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / (w : ℂ)) * t) = P t) → ∀ n : ℕ, ¬ w ∣ n → p.coeff n = 0
